meta.title: Window & Quit (dsh-window-control)
meta.description: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
